text:
## Dispute & Legal Holds  
**Litigation Hold:**
- Customer dispute or legal action
- Retain all relevant documents
- Document marked "Legal Hold"
- Cannot destroy during dispute
- Destroy 6 years after resolution  
**Regulatory Investigation:**
- Regulator requests hold
- Retain all specified documents
- Follow regulator timeline
- Destroy per regulator instruction

raw_entities.name: Dispute and Legal Holds Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the retention and destruction of documents during customer disputes, legal actions, and regulatory investigations. Establishes mandatory hold procedures, marking requirements, and destruction timelines based on dispute resolution or regulator instruction.
context: Litigation Hold: Customer dispute or legal action

raw_entities.name: Litigation Hold on Customer Dispute
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain all relevant documents when a customer dispute or legal action is initiated. Documents must be marked as 'Legal Hold' and cannot be destroyed during the dispute period.

raw_entities.name: Document Destruction Timeline After Dispute Resolution
raw_entities.description: Specifies that documents subject to litigation hold must be retained for 6 years following the resolution of a customer dispute or legal action before destruction is permitted.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Investigation Document Hold
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain all documents specified by a regulator when a regulatory investigation is initiated. The bank must follow the regulator's timeline and destroy documents only per regulator instruction.

raw_entities.name: Legal and Compliance Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk of non-compliance with legal obligations and regulatory requirements arising from improper document retention or destruction during disputes and investigations. Encompasses litigation exposure and regulatory sanction risk.

raw_entities.name: Legal Hold Document Marking
raw_entities.description: Operational control requiring documents subject to litigation hold to be explicitly marked as 'Legal Hold' to ensure they are not inadvertently destroyed and to maintain clear audit trail of hold status.

raw_entities.name: Regulator-Directed Document Retention
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring the bank to retain all documents specified by a regulator during an investigation and to follow the regulator's timeline for destruction, ensuring compliance with regulatory directives.

raw_entities.name: Regulator
raw_entities.description: External regulatory authority with the power to request document holds during investigations and to direct the timeline and manner of document destruction. The bank must comply with all regulator instructions regarding document retention.

raw_entities.name: Customer in Dispute
raw_entities.description: A customer engaged in a dispute or legal action with the bank, triggering mandatory document retention obligations and litigation hold procedures.
